nodes.label: Data Darwinism: Hierarchical Data Processing Framework
nodes.author: Yiwei Qin, Zhen Huang, Tiantian Mi, Weiye Si, Chenyang Zhou, Qipeng Guo, Siyuan Feng, Pengfei Liu
nodes.rationale: Ten-level hierarchy (L0-L9) organizing data transformations; co-evolutionary feedback loop between models and data; validates on scientific domain with Darwin-Science 900B-token corpus

nodes.label: Data Darwinism Hierarchy: L0-L5 Implementation
nodes.rationale: L0: Data Acquisition; L1: Format Normalization; L2: Rule-based Filtering; L3: Lightweight Model Filtering; L4: Generative Refinement (noise removal, fragmentation repair); L5: Cognitive Completion (reasoning reconstruction, terminological explication, pedagogical bridging)

nodes.label: Scientific Data Learnability Gap
nodes.rationale: Raw scientific data provides negligible gains despite high information density; high conceptual compression and implicit reasoning chains render content opaque to language models; L4-L5 processing bridges gap

nodes.label: Darwin-Science: Processed Scientific Corpus
nodes.rationale: 900B-token corpus spanning academic books and papers; natural sciences, engineering, medicine; implements L0-L5 hierarchy; outperforms baseline +2.12 (3B) and +2.95 (7B) on 20+ benchmarks

nodes.label: daVinci-origin Base Models: Contamination-Free Baselines
nodes.rationale: 3B and 7B models trained from scratch on 5.37T tokens excluding scientific content; enables unambiguous attribution of gains to data processing; clean-room evaluation framework

nodes.label: Darwin-Science-Eval: Expert-Level Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 150K expert-level questions from held-out scientific literature; distribution-aligned domain comprehension assessment; reveals 3× larger gains than standard evaluations

nodes.label: Data Darwinism defines processing hierarchy L0-L9
Data Darwinism Framework
nodes.rationale: Hierarchical framework organizing data transformations along three dimensions: selection to generation, preservation to transformation, human-centric to machine-driven. Conceptualizes data quality as co-evolving with model capabilities.

nodes.label: L0: Data Acquisition Level
nodes.rationale: Foundational stage collecting raw data from diverse sources (web scraping, databases). Handles largest volumes (terabytes to petabytes) in highly variable formats. Preserves original information landscape to maximize downstream flexibility.

nodes.label: L1: Format Normalization Level
nodes.rationale: Transforms heterogeneous data into unified, training-ready representations. Operations include OCR on PDFs/images, HTML parsing, audio/video transcription. Ensures uniform processability while preserving structural fidelity.

nodes.label: L2: Rule-based Filtering Level
nodes.rationale: First stage of quality control using deterministic, pattern-based mechanisms. Applies explicit rules to filter objectively identifiable problematic content (short/long documents, duplicates, garbled text, non-target languages, abnormal character ratios).

nodes.label: L3: Lightweight Model Filtering Level
nodes.rationale: Introduces machine learning-based classification using pre-trained lightweight models (FastText, small language models). Performs semantic-level judgments: topic categorization, domain identification, quality assessment, educational value evaluation.

nodes.label: L4: Generative Refinement Level
nodes.rationale: Marks shift from selection to active, model-driven refinement using medium-to-large generative models. Purifies content by removing extraneous noise and repairing structural/formatting defects while adhering to original content (faithful refiner constraint).

nodes.label: L5: Cognitive Completion Level
nodes.rationale: Employs generative models to explicate implicit reasoning and logical steps. Reconstructs 'chain of thought' for mathematical derivations, scientific arguments, instructional trajectories using Chain-of-Thought prompting and process supervision.

nodes.label: L6: Contextual Completion Level
nodes.rationale: Expands data by integrating external references and background knowledge. Resolves implicit dependencies through reference resolution and cross-referencing using semantic search and knowledge graph technologies.

nodes.label: L7: Environment Synthesis Level
nodes.rationale: Transcends content enrichment to construct executable, interactive environments. Synthesizes runtime conditions (OS configurations, Docker/VM specifications, experimental setups) required for reproducibility.

nodes.label: L8: Ecosystem Synthesis Level
nodes.rationale: Constructs dynamic multi-agent systems where diverse intelligent entities interact and evolve. Creates populated ecosystems with agents engaging in sustained collaboration, debate, strategy; generates emergent data through operation.

nodes.label: L9: World Synthesis Level
nodes.rationale: Theoretical apex of data processing: constructing comprehensive, physically and socially coherent simulated worlds. Creates alternative realities with internal logic, emergent civilizations, open-ended evolution using original data as seed.

nodes.label: Darwin-Science Corpus
nodes.rationale: Large-scale scientific corpus implementing L0-L5 of Data Darwinism framework. Comprises 50M documents totaling ~900B tokens across natural sciences, engineering, social sciences. Demonstrates systematic hierarchy ascension unlocking latent value in specialized domains.

nodes.label: Learnability Gap Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Raw scientific data suffers severe learnability gap: despite high information density and conceptual complexity, unprocessed content provides negligible training value. Low-level processing (L0-L3) yields negligible improvements; systematic hierarchy ascension essential.

nodes.label: daVinci-origin Foundation Models
nodes.rationale: Fully transparent foundation models trained from scratch (3B and 7B parameters) on 5.37T tokens excluding scientific content. Provides contamination-free base models with disclosed data recipe for studying domain-specific knowledge acquisition.

nodes.label: Darwin-Science-Eval Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Academic benchmark with 140K questions from books and 10K from papers, designed to evaluate specialized knowledge enhanced by Darwin-Science. Three-stage pipeline: Q&A generation, completeness filter, correctness filter.

nodes.label: Shortcut-Consistency Training
nodes.rationale: Training scheme aligning trajectories of different lengths, ensuring shorter loops yield informative representations while longer loops continue refining. Addresses learnability gap by making implicit reasoning explicit and adding pedagogical scaffolding.

nodes.label: OCR Processing Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Converts scanned PDFs to machine-readable text using olmOCR-7B-0225-preview, a 7B-parameter vision-language model optimized for document text extraction. Critical L1 operation for scientific corpus construction.

nodes.label: MinHash Deduplication
nodes.rationale: L2 filtering operation using MinHash with LSH (parameters nb=14, nh=8, 112 hash features per document). Removes 22% of documents through near-duplicate detection. Ensures data quality and reduces redundancy.

nodes.label: EAI-Distill Classification Model
nodes.rationale: Finetuned Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct model for 12-dimensional document classification (L3 filtering). Covers field of discipline classification, document type, content quality. Enables non-educational content filtering and discipline organization.

nodes.label: GPT-OSS-120B Refinement Model
nodes.rationale: Selected for L4 generative refinement due to optimal balance of accuracy and throughput. Processes 1,024 character chunks (~256 token windows) independently at scale. Results in 20% corpus volume reduction through faithful refinement.

nodes.label: Qwen3-235B Cognitive Completion Model
nodes.rationale: Selected for L5 cognitive completion based on LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Processes 1,024 token windows for papers (larger than L4 for narrative consistency). Reconstructs implicit reasoning, contextualizes jargon, provides pedagogical bridging.

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Reconstruction
nodes.rationale: L5 operation expanding logical leaps into step-by-step derivations. Allows models to trace causality between assumptions and conclusions. Targets three dimensions: reasoning reconstruction, terminological explication, pedagogical bridging.

nodes.label: Benchmark Construction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Three-stage pipeline for Darwin-Science-Eval: Q&A generation via Qwen3-32B with thinking mode, completeness filter (question independence), correctness filter (answer verifiability). Ensures high-quality evaluation grounded in original text.

nodes.label: Foundation Model Pretraining Dataset
nodes.rationale: 5.37T tokens across three components: CC (4.28T from Nemotron-CC non-synthetic), Math (493B from MegaMath and Nemotron-CC-Math-v1), Code (598B from GitHub, Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v1, Stack Exchange). Excludes scientific content for contamination-free evaluation.

nodes.label: Data Composition Strategy Analysis
nodes.rationale: Optimal scientific content ratio peaks at 50% for general benchmarks (inverted-U pattern), while aligned benchmarks increase monotonically. Book-paper balance shows complementary value; 1:2 ratio adopted reflecting data availability. Goal-dependent optimization essential.

nodes.label: Processing Strategy Analysis
nodes.rationale: L5 variants surpass L4 baseline (OSS-120B: +0.75, Qwen3-235B: +1.27 points). Teacher model quality critical: Qwen3-235B yields +0.52 gain over OSS-120B. Cognitive completion adds distinct value beyond generative refinement.

nodes.label: Context Length Requirements
nodes.rationale: Extended 32K context window (RoPE base=1,000,000) outperforms standard 4K (RoPE base=10,000) by +0.80 points. Initial adaptation phase observed; 32K model progressively pulls ahead, indicating long-context advantages emerge gradually.

nodes.label: Training Stage Consistency
nodes.rationale: Scientific data effective at both early (930B tokens) and late (4T tokens) training stages. Early-stage gains (+0.98) comparable to late-stage (+0.76), confirming scientific data remains effective for mature models and early checkpoints serve as reliable proxies.
